**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The RadialSpark consulting agreement contains no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right binding Clear Capital. I checked all sections (Preamble, §§ 1–7) and ran targeted searches for *audit*, *records/books/inspect/verification*, *access*, and *monitor/premises/examine/usage/compliance/on-site*:

- **§ 3 (Compensation)** — fee substantiation flows one way only: Contractor must supply invoice detail, dates, hours and expense receipts (p0014). There is no right for RadialSpark to examine our books or records.
- **§ 1(c) (p0007)** — the only access language runs in our favour: Contractor personnel at our facility must comply with our safety, security and computer-system access policies.
- **§§ 4–7** — ownership/acceptance, warranties, termination and liability contain no inspection or verification mechanic.

Because no audit right attaches to Customer, the AUDIT parameters (annual frequency, 30/15 days' notice, business hours, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, off-site review, Vendor-borne cost, no system access) have nothing to qualify, and there is no walk-away exposure (no unlimited, unannounced or remote-access audit). Consistent with the playbook, I have not drafted an audit clause: creating a qualified audit right where none exists would hand RadialSpark a right it does not currently have.
